protocol:
Spot-on-lawn (halo) assay for screening enrichment cultures and isolates for viruses
Gelrite plates are preincubated ca.
10 min at 80˚C to dry.
10 mL of Sulfolobus medium with ca. 0.2 % (w/v) Gelrite is boiled to dissolve the Gelrite.
This “softlayer” is allowed to cool slightly (to ca. 80˚C).
Approximately 3 mL of softlayer are added to ca. 0.2 mL of exponentially growing host cells, generally Sulfolobus solfataricus, and spread on a plate by swirling.
After the Gelrite solidifies, 1–2 µL of culture or supernatant to be screened is spotted on the plate.
For a positive control, 1 µL of a 0.01% (v/v) Triton X-100 solution is spotted.
Plates are incubated as above for 2–3 d and plates examined for clearing around spots (Fig. 1D in guidelines).

parameters.reagent: culture or supernatant to be screened

script:
# Lab Automation Script

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
incubate(container='Gelrite plates', temperature='80˚C', duration='10 min')
heat(container='Sulfolobus medium with Gelrite', reagent='Sulfolobus medium with ca. 0.2 % (w/v) Gelrite', volume='10 mL', temperature='boiling', purpose='to dissolve Gelrite')
cool(container='softlayer (Sulfolobus medium with Gelrite)', temperature='ca. 80˚C')
dispense(container='host cell suspension', reagent='softlayer', volume='3 mL', recipient_volume='0.2 mL', recipient_reagent='exponentially growing host cells (Sulfolobus solfataricus)')
mix(container='plate', reagent='softlayer + host cells', volume='total ca. 3.2 mL', method='spread by swirling')
wait(container='plate', duration='until Gelrite solidifies')
dispense(container='plate', reagent='culture or supernatant to be screened', volume='1–2 µL', method='spot')
dispense(container='plate', reagent='0.01% (v/v) Triton X-100 solution', volume='1 µL', purpose='positive control', method='spot')
incubate(container='plates', temperature='as above (likely 80˚C)', duration='2–3 d')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: observe (container: plates, other: {'purpose': 'examine for clearing around spots'})
